extracts.content: A protein intake of 1.6 to 2.2 grams per kilogram of body weight is sufficient for most lifters to maximize muscle growth. During a fat-loss phase, higher intakes (up to 2.5g/kg) may be beneficial to preserve lean body mass.

The foundation of any body composition goal is energy balance. To lose fat, a caloric deficit is required. To gain muscle optimally, a small caloric surplus is generally recommended, though beginners can often gain muscle at maintenance calories.
